_comment: Golden vector for the sealed-box wire format (ADR 0002). The payload was produced by the TypeScript implementation in supabase/functions/link-garmin/index.ts, using @noble/curves, @noble/hashes and @noble/ciphers -- the same libraries the deployed Edge Function uses. test_sealing_interop.py asserts the Python side can open it. If that test fails, the two implementations have drifted and account linking would store credentials the sync service can never read. Regenerate only when the format is changed deliberately, and bump the version byte when you do.
